scientific_integrity: Self-contained infinite proof with an explicit matching-based witness; independent adjacency-based finite checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Statement restricted to integers \(k\ge3\), \(n\ge k+1\), and two-subset Kneser graphs. It does not count minimizers or establish independent external verification; older equivalent Cartesian-product results may exist.
title: Exact multi-rainbow domination of two-subset Kneser graphs
